title: Quisiera or Querría? A Softer Result Clause
goal: Use quisiera, pudiera and debiera as softer forms of querría, podría and debería, and know that the conditional stays the normal form.
grammar: The -ra form in place of the conditional

items: I can use quisiera, pudiera and debiera as softer forms of querría, podría and debería.
I can use the conditional for every other verb in the result clause.
I can use the new words for formal and measured speech.
